args.body:
I need to report an error in the 3% price-list increase I applied on 2026-10-14 at your request. Fixed-price contract products were to be excluded, but 22 products marked FIXED-PRICE CONTRACT (P-1201 through P-1222) were increased 3%.

Effect: since then, 8 orders (SO-77310 to SO-77317) have been placed at the increased prices. Total overcharge is $4,128.60. I have not changed any prices today.

Proposed next step: revert list prices on P-1201 through P-1222 to the pre-increase amounts, and have sales/finance credit the 8 orders. Please confirm if you want me to revert those 22 list prices.

I’ve asked Lena Ortiz to confirm a list-price revert and credits for those orders.
